feeds.title: Engage Selling Blog
feeds.description: Colleen Francis from Engage Selling shares her sales insights for an immediate and lasting impact on your sales results! Colleen works with business and sales leaders to synergize the sales DNA of the organization to seize market opportunities. Whether designing a strategy to target a new market or working with a team to improve its productivity, Colleen's results have attracted clients.

feeds.title: Connect Leader Blog
feeds.description: Connect Leader's Sales Engagement Platform helps reach your best B2B sales leads fast through phone, email, text, video, and social. Connect Leader's B2B sales blog shares productivity tips, tools, news, and other relevant information to professionals interested in sales productivity, demand generation and more.

feeds.title: Blair Singer Blog
feeds.description: Do you want help with Sales, Team Building, Teaching, Entrepreneurship? This site is designed to help Entrepreneurs, Business Owners, and Leaders get the education they need to be leaders in their expertise or field. Blair Singer is a Rich Dad Advisor, specializing in leadership and sales.

feeds.title: Jeff Bajorek
feeds.description: Focuses on sales leadership, sales mindset, sales process, and sales prospecting. Jeff Bajorek is a top sales performer with more than a decade of field experience who teaches individuals and businesses to rethink the way you sell through training and workshops, speaking and seminars, and leadership and business consulting.

feeds.title: Carew » Sales Leadership Blog
feeds.description: Carew International offers top quality corporate sales professional leadership development to give your company a competitive edge. Carew International discusses topics on the critical role of leadership development in the success of any organization.

feeds.title: Sales Leadership Blog
feeds.description: The Selling Power Sales Leadership Blog showcases insights, ideas, advice about issues related to B2B sales and marketing. Posts are written by top-level sales and marketing leaders across all industries.

feeds.title: McLeod & More Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Earle McLeod is a leading authority on sales leadership and the author of four provocative books including the bestseller, Selling with Noble Purpose. Companies like Apple, Kimberly-Clark, and Pfizer hire her to help them create passionate, purpose-driven sales organization.
